memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild knee pain on walking, manages household chores with occasional assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw normal), no immediate concern.
falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 11 seconds, within normal range.
medicines: 6 regular (paracetamol SOS, topical diclofenac gel, calcium‑vit D3 OD, atorvastatin 10 mg HS, tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; enjoys time with grandchildren.
carers: Sarita, daughter.
goal: "I want to stay active enough to play with my grandkids."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
paracetamol 650 mg SOS
 topical diclofenac gel apply to knees BD
 calcium 500 mg + vitamin D3 400 IU OD
 atorvastatin 10 mg HS
 tiotropium inhaler 2 puffs OD
 salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs SOS
 budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (opt <100), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 162 mg/dL (<150).
Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (7-56), AST 24 U/L (8-48), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 32 U/L (9-64), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).
Creatine kinase: 112 U/L (30-200).
Serum vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (sufficient >30).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.42 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.30 L (78% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.62 (below 0.70) – consistent with COPD, moderate obstruction.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X-ray: hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrate or pleural effusion.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Weight-bearing X-ray both knees: mild joint space narrowing medially, osteophyte formation, no severe degeneration.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past month my right knee hurts more when I climb stairs; I’ve been using extra paracetamol and the gel helps a little. My breathing feels okay, but I notice I get tired faster on walks.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-10-10 at 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (Geriatrics).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Weight-bearing X-ray both knees: progression of medial joint space narrowing, moderate osteophytes; no subchondral cyst.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: knee pain worse on stairs, uses walking stick occasionally; ADLs independent with minor difficulty.
cognition: Mini-Cog repeated 3/5, stable.
falls: one fall in last 12 months (tripped on rug, no injury); gait slightly antalgic; timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk; advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 7 regular (added fenofibrate 145 mg OD, switched atorvastatin to rosuvastatin 10 mg OD); polypharmacy – request Beers review.
mood: reports occasional frustration with limitation, denies depression.
carers: Sarita, daughter.
goal: "I want to walk to the market without stopping."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
paracetamol 650 mg SOS
 topical diclofenac gel BD
 calcium 500 mg + vitamin D3 400 IU OD
 rosuvastatin 10 mg OD
 fenofibrate 145 mg OD
 tiotropium inhaler OD
 salbutamol inhaler SOS
 budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: LDL 112 mg/dL, HDL 44 mg/dL, triglycerides 138 mg/dL.
Vitamin D: 28 ng/mL (still suboptimal).
Liver enzymes unchanged.
Creatine kinase: 158 U/L.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Pulmonology, Dr S. Reddy, for worsening COPD symptoms and to assess need for escalation of inhaled therapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonologist advises continuing current inhalers, adds short course of oral prednisolone 20 mg OD for 5 days due to recent exacerbation, recommends annual flu vaccine and pneumococcal booster.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: New maculopapular rash on both knees after applying topical diclofenac gel; onset 2 days after use, resolved with discontinuation and antihistamine. Allergy to topical NSAID documented.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: knee pain improved after stopping diclofenac gel, uses paracetamol SOS only; walks with stick, manages shopping.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5, stable.
falls: no new falls; gait improved; timed up-and-go 10 seconds – within normal.
medicines: 6 regular (paracetamol SOS, calcium‑vit D3 OD, rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD); polypharmacy – note Beers review due.
mood: feels happier, enjoys gardening with daughter.
carers: Sarita, daughter.
goal: "I want to be pain‑free enough to attend my granddaughter’s wedding."
